result.question: How did Uzziah trespass against Yahweh, his God, when he became powerful?
result.answer: He entered the temple of Yahweh to burn incense on the altar of incense.
result.reason: The supplied windows directly support the original wording: Uzziah entered the temple for the purpose of burning incense. This repair avoids the unsupported claim that he actually completed the burning.
